# Manual cross-version queue qualification

`TestOld55QueuedPrivateServingRefusesUnprovenFloorAfterUpgrade` needs an explicit `-old55-proof` directory. It never touches the default user home or a provider rental. It boots one actual CPU Host with CUDA hidden, while the provider catalog is a stand-in. H3 package metadata and code are read from the real public catalog; no model weights or H3 inference run.

The old CLI is the exact source9afc0c619590fc71177d34cd32df0a84f91fc03f binary SHA25688bc5f0ad1d87d8c6646b69c9dbe32810414a6e38c972502e9bf0fc64c6476f3. Compile seed.go as a tests/support command against that same old source, so it creates real records schema39. The new test process opens schema40 only after the old CLI submits and its daemon exits. Do not fake an old schema by editing PRAGMA user_version.

The directory contains `cozy-old55`, `seed`, `launch.py`, `manifest.json` naming actual CPU imagea61cff5a2827d89f73163770dfa6c58174dc747da2420ae80b3c5c1287c15708 (Runtime0.18.1/native55/TensorFS0.3.43), `old-runtime-bin` and `new-runtime-bin` pointing at source-qualified tools, an old sourcef084 weightless `project` from build-weightless.py, `catalog-public.json` with the public Hub URL, `gpu-image-inventory.json` measured from the candidate CUDA image, and valid `h3-input.json`. The GPU inventory is used only by a provider stand-in whose endpoint never executes work. Set TMPDIR to a new directory inside this proof root and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' for the Go test.

Verified behavior: the original private wheel/payload/request identity survives migration, but its missing controller-authored Runtime floor marker causes a typed pre-attempt refusal. This proves that existing old queues must drain before upgrade; it does not authorize replacing or replaying their requests. Separately, code-only installation of exact H3 1.14.3 and a new normal public serving submission succeed and remain published requests, not private captures. Execution and video proof still require a real matching GPU cohort.

Evidence for the 2026-09-14 run is under outputs/h3-general-lora-20260914/integration-finish/old55-proof/run-011.log and home-1496424446. All task CPU containers and owned daemons are stopped by the fixture; saved request/capture evidence remains for review.
